podcast.title: Meeting at a Converge Show
podcast.body: George Pettit and Dallas Green met Liam from Cancer Bats (who was then in Vincent Black Shadow) while waiting in line to see a Converge show, highlighting the close-knit nature of the underground music scene where many of these artists connected. "George and I met, we met Liam from the Cancer Bats in line at a Converge show."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Alexisonfire - In Their Own Words Podcast

xref.title: Shared Influence
xref.body: Converge was a band that all members of Alexis on Fire "kind of came together" on as an influence. George Pettit and Dallas Green even met Liam from Cancer Bats at a Converge show, indicating its significance in their formative musical experiences. "Converge, I think we all kind of came together."
